# LEGGE 15 ottobre 2013, n. 119 (in G.U. n. 242 del 15 ottobre 2013 - in vigore dal 16 ottobre 2013) - Conversione in legge, con modificazioni, del decreto-legge 

LEGGE 15 ottobre 2013,  
n. 119 (in G.U. n. 242 del 15 ottobre 2013 - in vigore dal 16 ottobre 2013) - Conversione in legge, con modificazioni, del decreto-legge 14 agosto 2013,  
n. 93, recante disposizioni urgenti in materia di sicurezza e per il contrasto della violenza di genere, nonchè in tema di protezione civile e di commissariamento delle province. (13G00163)
La Camera dei deputati ed il Senato della Repubblica hanno approvato;  
IL PRESIDENTE DELLA REPUBBLICA
Promulga la seguente legge:

### Art. 1

1. Il decreto-legge 14 agosto 2013,  
n. 93, recante disposizioni urgenti in materia di sicurezza e per il contrasto della violenza di genere, nonchè in tema di protezione civile e di commissariamento delle province, è convertito in legge con le modificazioni riportate in allegato alla presente legge.  
2. La presente legge entra in vigore il giorno successivo a quello della sua pubblicazione nella Gazzetta Ufficiale.

### Art. 2

1. Fermo restando quanto previsto dall'articolo 1, comma 115, della legge 24 dicembre 2012,  
n. 228, sono fatti salvi i provvedimenti di scioglimento degli organi e di nomina dei commissari straordinari delle amministrazioni provinciali, adottati, in applicazione dell'articolo 23, comma 20, del decreto-legge 6 dicembre 2011,  
n. 201, convertito, con modificazioni, dalla legge 22 dicembre 2011,  
n. 214, ai sensi dell'articolo 141 del testo unico di cui al decreto legislativo 18 agosto 2000,  
n. 267, e successive modificazioni, nonchè gli atti e i provvedimenti adottati, alla data di entrata in vigore della presente legge, dai medesimi commissari straordinari.  
2. Fino al 30 giugno 2014 è sospesa l'applicazione delle disposizioni di cui all'articolo 2, comma 2, secondo e terzo periodo, del decreto-legge 6 luglio 2012,  
n. 95, convertito, con modificazioni, dalla legge 7 agosto 2012,  
n. 135.  
La presente legge, munita del sigillo dello Stato, sarà inserita nella Raccolta ufficiale degli atti normativi della Repubblica italiana. È fatto obbligo a chiunque spetti di osservarla e di farla osservare come legge dello Stato.  
Data a Roma, addì 15 ottobre 2013.  
NAPOLITANO
Letta, Presidente del Consiglio dei ministri
Alfano, Ministro dell'interno
Giovannini, Ministro del lavoro e delle politiche sociali
Cancellieri, Ministro della giustizia
Visto, il Guardasigilli: Cancellieri

# LAW 15 October 2013, no. 119 (in Official Gazette no. 242 of 15 October 2013 - in force from 16 October 2013) - Conversion into law, with amendments, of the decree-law

LAW 15 October 2013,  
no. 119 (in Official Gazette no. 242 of 15 October 2013 - in force from 16 October 2013) - Conversion into law, with amendments, of decree-law 14 August 2013,  
no. 93, containing urgent provisions on security and for combating gender-based violence, as well as on civil protection and the commissioning of provinces. (13G00163)
The Chamber of Deputies and the Senate of the Republic have approved;  
THE PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC
Promulgates the following law:

### Art. 1

1. Decree-law 14 August 2013,  
no. 93, containing urgent provisions on security and for combating gender-based violence, as well as on civil protection and the commissioning of provinces, is converted into law with the amendments set out in the annex to this law.  
2. This law shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Gazette.

### Art. 2

1. Without prejudice to the provisions of Article 1, paragraph 115, of Law 24 December 2012,  
no. 228, the measures for the dissolution of bodies and the appointment of extraordinary commissioners of provincial administrations are preserved, adopted in application of Article 23, paragraph 20, of decree-law 6 December 2011,  
no. 201, converted, with amendments, by Law 22 December 2011,  
no. 214, pursuant to Article 141 of the consolidated text referred to in Legislative Decree 18 August 2000,  
no. 267, and subsequent amendments, as well as the acts and measures adopted, at the date of entry into force of this law, by the same extraordinary commissioners.  
2. Until 30 June 2014, the application of the provisions referred to in Article 2, paragraph 2, second and third sentences, of decree-law 6 July 2012,  
no. 95, converted, with amendments, by Law 7 August 2012,  
no. 135, is suspended.  
This law, bearing the seal of the State, shall be inserted in the Official Collection of normative acts of the Italian Republic. Everyone to whom it applies is obliged to observe it and to ensure that it is observed as law of the State.  
Given in Rome, on 15 October 2013.  
NAPOLITANO
Letta, President of the Council of Ministers
Alfano, Minister of the Interior
Giovannini, Minister of Labour and Social Policies
Cancellieri, Minister of Justice

### Art. 3

Misura di prevenzione per condotte di violenza domestica
1. Nei casi in cui alle forze dell'ordine sia segnalato, (( in forma non anonima )), un fatto che debba ritenersi riconducibile (( ai reati di cui agli articoli 581, nonchè 582, secondo comma, consumato o tentato, del codice penale, )) nell'ambito di violenza domestica, il questore, anche in assenza di querela, può procedere, assunte le informazioni necessarie da parte degli organi investigativi e sentite le persone informate dei fatti, all'ammonimento dell'autore del fatto. Ai fini del presente articolo si intendono per violenza domestica (( uno o più atti, gravi ovvero non episodici, )) di violenza fisica, sessuale, psicologica o economica che si verificano all'interno della famiglia o del nucleo familiare (( o tra persone legate, attualmente o in passato, da un vincolo di matrimonio o da una relazione affettiva, )) indipendentemente dal fatto che l'autore di tali atti condivida o abbia condiviso la stessa residenza con la vittima.

n. 11, convertito, con modificazioni, dalla legge 23 aprile 2009,

Il prefetto dispone la sospensione della patente di guida ai sensi dell'articolo 218 del (( codice della strada, di cui )) al decreto legislativo 30 aprile 1992,

Tutela per gli stranieri vittime di violenza domestica
1. Dopo l'articolo 18 del testo unico delle disposizioni concernenti la disciplina dell'immigrazione e norme sulla condizione dello straniero di cui al decreto legislativo 25 luglio 1998,  
n. 286, è (( inserito )) il seguente:
"Art. 18-bis
(Permesso di soggiorno per le vittime di violenza domestica)
"1. ### Art. 3

Preventive measure for domestic violence conduct
1. In cases where law enforcement agencies receive a report, (( in non-anonymous form )), of a fact that must be considered attributable (( to the offences referred to in articles 581, as well as 582, second paragraph, completed or attempted, of the criminal code, )) in the context of domestic violence, the quaestor, even in the absence of a complaint, may proceed, having obtained the necessary information from the investigative bodies and having heard the persons informed of the facts, to issue a warning to the perpetrator of the act. For the purposes of this article, domestic violence means (( one or more acts, serious or non-episodic, )) of physical, sexual, psychological or economic violence that occur within the family or family unit (( or between persons linked, currently or in the past, by a bond of marriage or by an emotional relationship, )) regardless of whether the perpetrator of such acts shares or has shared the same residence with the victim.  
2. The provisions of article 8, paragraphs 1 and 2, of decree-law 23 February 2009,  
no. 11, converted, with amendments, by law 23 April 2009,  
no. 38, (( as amended by this decree )), apply insofar as compatible. The quaestor may request from the prefect of the place of residence of the recipient of the warning the application of the measure of suspension of the driving licence for a period from one to three months. no. 285. The prefect does not proceed with the suspension of the driving licence if, taking into account the economic conditions of the family unit, it appears that the work requirements of the person concerned cannot be guaranteed by the issue of the permit referred to in article 218, (( paragraph 2, )) of the aforementioned legislative decree no. 285 of 1992.  
3. The Ministry of the Interior - Department of Public Security, also through the data contained in the Data Processing Centre referred to in article 8 of law 1 April 1981,  
no. 121, prepares annually a criminological analysis of gender-based violence which constitutes an autonomous section of the annual report to Parliament referred to in article 113 of the aforementioned law no. 121 of 1981.  
4. In every act of the procedure for the adoption of the warning referred to in paragraph 1, the personal details of the person reporting must be omitted, (( unless the report proves to be manifestly unfounded. The report may be used only for the purposes of initiating the procedure. ))
5. The measures referred to in paragraph 1 of article 11 of decree-law 23 February 2009,  
no. 11, converted, with amendments, by law 23 April 2009,  
no. 38, also apply in cases where law enforcement agencies, health facilities and public institutions receive from the victim information (( of the offences referred to in articles 581 and 582 of the criminal code in the context of domestic violence referred to in paragraph 1 of this article.

### Art. 4

Protection for foreign victims of domestic violence
1. After article 18 of the consolidated text of provisions concerning the regulation of immigration and rules on the status of foreigners referred to in legislative decree 25 July 1998,  
no. 286, the following is (( inserted )):
"Art. 18-bis
(Residence permit for victims of domestic violence)
"1. When, in the course of police operations, investigations or proceedings for any of the offences provided for in articles 572, 582, 583, 583-bis, 605, 609-bis and 612-bis of the criminal code or for one of the offences provided for in article 380 of the code of criminal procedure, committed on national territory in the context of domestic violence, situations of violence or abuse against a foreigner are ascertained and a concrete and current danger to his or her safety emerges, as a consequence of the choice to escape from the same violence or as a result of statements made during the preliminary investigations or the trial, the quaestor, (( with the favourable opinion of the proceeding judicial authority or on the proposal of the latter, )) issues a residence permit pursuant to article 5, paragraph 6, to enable the victim to escape from the violence. For the purposes of this article, domestic violence means (( one or more acts, serious or non-episodic, )) of physical, sexual, psychological or economic violence that occur within the family or family unit or (( between persons linked, currently or in the past, by a bond of marriage or by an emotional relationship, )) regardless of whether the perpetrator of such acts shares or has shared the same residence with the victim.  
2. With the proposal or opinion referred to in paragraph 1, the elements from which the existence of the conditions indicated therein results are communicated to the quaestor, with particular reference to the seriousness and current nature of the danger to personal safety.  
3. The same residence permit may be issued by the quaestor when situations of violence or abuse emerge in the course of assistance interventions (( by anti-violence centres, territorial social services or )) social services specialised in assisting victims of violence. 4. The residence permit referred to in paragraphs 1 and 3 is revoked in the event of conduct incompatible with the purposes thereof, reported by the public prosecutor or, as far as concerns their competence, by the social services referred to in paragraph 3, or in any case ascertained by the quaestor, or when the conditions that justified its issue cease to exist.

5. The provisions of this article also apply, insofar as compatible, to citizens of Member States of the European Union and their family members.".

b) the number of public and private anti-violence centres already existing in each region;  
c) the number of public and private shelters already existing in each region;  
d) the need to rebalance the presence of anti-violence centres and shelters in each region, reserving one third of the available funds for the establishment of new centres and new shelters in order to achieve the objective set out in the recommendation of the Expert Meeting on violence against women - Finland, 8-10 November 1999.  
3. Anti-violence centres and shelters, for which anonymity is guaranteed, are promoted by:
a) local authorities, individually or in associated form;  
b) associations and organisations operating in the field of support and assistance to women victims of violence, which have acquired specific experience and expertise in the field of violence against women, which use a reception methodology based on relationships between women, with specifically trained personnel;  
c) entities referred to in letters a) and b), jointly, in agreement or in consortium form.  
4. Anti-violence centres and shelters operate in an integrated manner with the network of territorial social, health and welfare services, taking into account the fundamental needs for the protection of persons suffering violence, even when they perform functions of specialist services.  
5. Irrespective of the intervention methodologies adopted and the specific professional profiles of the operators involved, the training of professional figures in anti-violence centres and shelters promotes an integrated approach to the phenomena of violence, in order to ensure recognition of the different dimensions of violence suffered by persons, at relational, physical, psychological, social, cultural and economic level. The training of operators in anti-violence centres and shelters also includes recognition of the dimensions of violence attributable to gender inequalities.  
6. The regions receiving the resources subject to distribution shall submit to the Minister delegated for equal opportunities, by 30 March of each year, a report concerning the initiatives adopted in the previous year using those resources.  
7. On the basis of the information provided by the regions, the Minister delegated for equal opportunities shall submit to the Chambers, by 30 June of each year, a report on the state of use of the resources allocated pursuant to this article. ))
